मङ्क्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To go, Bhaṭṭ. 14, 10.
 2. † To adorn.
मङ्कुर, m. A mirror; cf. मुकुर.

मङ्क्तृ, i. e. मज्ज् + त्रि, m., f. त्री, and n.
 1. Bathing or drowning.
 2. Cleaning by immersion.

मङ्क्षु, ind. (= नक्षु),
 1. Quickly, instantly.
 2. Much, exceedingly.
मङ्क्षुण, n. Armour for the thighs or legs.
मङ्ग, m. The head of a boat.
